description: NaMgLaTeO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.85 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-26°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.12 Å. La is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.84 Å. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-26°. There are five shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (1.96 Å) Te-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one La, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one La, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, two equivalent La, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, one La, and one Te atom.
